name: @veltravia/sandbox-core
description: Veltravia AI Sandbox Engine core: provider-neutral secure code-execution abstraction. Sandboxes, lifecycle, command policy (allowlist + hard denylist, no shells), environment isolation (no host inheritance), network policy (disabled by default), resource limits with hard ceilings, bounded + scrubbed output, audit events. Zero dependencies; executes nothing itself - all execution flows through the SandboxRuntime isolation-boundary adapter.
